text.tspan: 1.If a Hard Disk is installed in the computer, remove it.
2.Remove the top cover from the computer.
3.Locate and remove the Floppy Disk Controller Chip at
location U409. Replace it with the AJAX chip part
4.If the TOS ROMs in the computer are lower than REV
3.06, replace them with REV 3.06 TOS ROMs part
5.Locate switch J203 on the main PCB and turn segment 7
6.Set the jumpers on the rear of the 1.44 megabyte floppy
7.Remove the 1MB floppy drive from the top cover and
replace it with the 2MB floppy drive part number
Be sure to install the drive into the mounting bracket
